question: Can the four records added by route12/B20 be evaluated as an incremental correction to an already-computed B16 routed output without materially changing the terminal distribution?
frozen_observations: B16 and B20 are prefixes of the same stable score ordering.
B20 adds exactly four selected route-slab records to B16 when the calibrated route set is unchanged.
Each natural slab owns an independent 256-neuron gate/up activation block and corresponding down-projection block, so its expert-output contribution is algebraically additive.
B16 and B20 agreed on all three registered ordinary fixtures and disagreed at the registered get_weather boundary, where B20 was native-correct.

fixture.prompt: Implement a Python function that parses JSON and returns sorted unique keys.

protocol.trajectory: Cold scalar prefill follows the exact teacher. Only the final prompt row at the named routed layer uses the candidate provider.
protocol.candidate: Construct the same Budget20 selected set as a Budget16 base followed by the four-record correction sum(exact_slab_output - stored_slab_mean). Read exactly the same 20 authoritative records as control.
protocol.implementation_scope: Host-reference experimental path only. No cache, risk predictor, production path, or throughput claim.
protocol.anti_tuning: Run one control and one incremental arm at each registered layer. Do not alter prompt, layers, budgets, routes, model, or gates after observing an arm.

structural: For every evaluated row, the Budget16 plan is an exact prefix/subset of Budget20 and the delta has exactly four records.
Control and candidate plan traces select the same 20 records and account the same logical authoritative bytes.
Control and candidate exact-teacher terminal logits are byte-identical.
quality: Incremental and ordinary Budget20 terminal top-1 IDs agree at all three layers.
Full-vocabulary KL(control Budget20 || incremental Budget20) is <= 1e-6 at every layer.
Absolute change in terminal KL versus exact teacher is <= 1e-4 at every layer.
gates.go: All structural and quality gates pass. This earns an all-layer behavioral incremental-rescue experiment, not production code.
gates.no_go: Any structural failure, top-1 change, or KL threshold failure closes this composition/order and forbids a progressive runtime based on it.
gates.production: No production transplant is authorized by this discriminator.
